notes.title: Version 1.12 released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] after a Boss dies any remaining shots also get destroyed
[*] enemies and bonus-capsule now much better visible on radar
[*] Steam screenshot-function implemented
[*] more shot-speedup-energy from asteroids and energy-absorber-shield
[*] shot-speedup-energy slowly recharges itself now, may still need some balancing
[*] some new sounds
[*] some bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11 released
notes.content: Made Level 64 a bit easier, so humans may beat it ;)

notes.title: Version 1.10 released
notes.content:
Made level 1-20 a bit harder and more interesting, especially level 1-10 were thought for learning the controls but seemed to boring. So I added some nice enemy formations. 

Thanks to STG shoot’em up(shmup)_JP for the nice review and suggestions (as far as I can translate it 😉 ).
